notes: Statistical harness for Gaussian samplers: mean, variance and tail fractions within z = 4 standard errors. The draws here come from Box–Muller over a Mersenne Twister stream so the file is reproducible; a real (discrete) sampler is checked the same way over its own draws.

cases.description: The same draws at twice the scale fail the variance and tail checks

inputs.draws_rule: each of the draws of the first case times 2

cases.description: Draws shifted by 0.5 fail the mean check

inputs.draws_rule: each of the draws of the first case plus 0.5

cases.description: Draws clipped at 2σ fail the 2σ tail check (4000 draws give the 3σ check little power; use 20,000 or more for a real sampler)

inputs.draws_rule: each of the draws of the first case clipped to [-5, 5]

cases.description: The same draws rounded to integers (a stand-in for a discrete Gaussian at σ 2.5) still pass

inputs.draws_rule: each of the draws of the first case rounded to the nearest integer
